data.name: Daniel
data.gender_notes: Daniel is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Daniyyel: dan, 'judge', + El, 'God' — 'God is my judge'. Its root is Hebrew d-n-ʾ-l. The prophet Daniel; the Book of Daniel. Daniel is a Hebrew name meaning “God is my judge”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Daniel expresses “God is my judge”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Daniyyel: dan, 'judge', + El, 'God' — 'God is my judge'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daniel total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
